summary: Fix D-056 substrate: ci/checks/agent-instruction-runtime-dormant.sh (FF-COMP-6) was RED on a clean dev checkout (dev@b50308be) — its src/http detector (grep -rlE) is comment-unaware, and two pure documentation comments in src/http/agents.ts (byte-identical to origin/dev) tripped it, masking npm run fitness's honest signal on every branch. The gate is right in spirit; only its pattern was wrong. FIX (rev 3, after judge R1+R2): strip_comment_substrings() — a string-aware per-character POSIX-awk scanner that strips comment SUBSTRINGS (inline + multi-line /* */ spans; // tails unless inside a string literal; hash comments ONLY for non-.ts/.js files) while preserving string literals (dquote/squote/backtick-template, escape-aware) — then re-applies the unchanged pattern (file_has_code_level_agent_instruction_hit()). R1 (judge #1, blocking, fixed): the first revision stripped whole physical lines by leading comment opener, hiding a code hit after a leading same-line /* */. R2 (judge #2, blocking, same class, fixed): the R1 revision kept a full-line hash rule that dropped a TS line-leading private-field declaration `#rows = q(...)` (a real read); hash stripping is now EXTENSION-GATED so a hash in any position is code in .ts/.js. Both judge shapes pinned as permanent --self-test probes (13 total) and re-proven RED as live mutations. Diff against BASE_REF is 100% pure insertion (0 deletions on all governed files; the reworks replace only this task's own prior insertions) — verified by git diff --numstat and by ci/checks/auto-sanction-additive.sh --verify (A-1..A-4 PASS).

judge_r2_rework.fix: hash-comment stripping is now gated on file extension (strip_hash var, set in bash from the path, passed to awk with -v). Disabled (strip_hash=0) for .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mts/.cts/.mjs/.cjs — TS/JS has no hash comments, so a hash in ANY position (line-leading or mid-line) is a private class field = code. Enabled (strip_hash=1) only for non-TS/JS (shell-style) files, and as the default for unknown/extensionless paths (false-positive-leaning). This gate only scans src/http/*.ts, so in practice hash is always code here.
